title: Control Panel
context: What is waiting on you, and what changed recently. Move between areas using the side menu. You only see the areas your role allows.

roleError.title: We could not check your access.
roleError.body: No approval or audit work is shown.

noPanels.title: No admin panels are assigned to this role
noPanels.body: Use the pages listed in the side menu.

waiting.title: Waiting on you
waiting.desc: Submitted requests you are allowed to approve. Your own requests never appear here. One person writes and a different person approves.
waiting.loadErrorTitle: Some approval work could not load.
waiting.loadErrorList: The request list could not be loaded. Requests may exist that are not shown.
waiting.loadErrorDetail: We could not read some request details, but the requests below are still shown.
waiting.empty: No requests are waiting on your approval

audit.title: Recent configuration changes
audit.desc: Approved changes you're allowed to see, taken directly from the Activity Log. Nothing here is summarized or guessed.
audit.loadErrorBody: The Activity Log could not be loaded. Changes may exist that are not shown.
audit.empty: No changes returned for this area
